create_chat_completion_with_lora_adapter: create a chat completion using a LoRA adapter specified in the model parameter with adapter:name syntax
create_completion_with_lora_adapter: create a text completion using a LoRA adapter specified in the model parameter with adapter:name syntax
create_chat_completion_with_explicit_lor: create a chat completion using an explicit lora_path parameter in extra_body for backward compatibility
create_chat_completion_with_base_model: create a chat completion using the base model without any LoRA adapter
run_lora_examples: run the SGLang OpenAI-compatible LoRA adapter example script
